in_marathi.name: Gurmeet
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Meet of the Guru
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gurmeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who meets the guru, receives the divine knowledge. In Sanskrit, 'gur' means teacher and 'meet' means meet. The name embodies the spirit of seeking knowledge from a wise guide.
